snippet.title: Pre-release teaser for The Kepler Experiment
snippet.description:
The Kepler Experiment is a survival-horror first-person shooter, taking inspiration from classic FPS games.
It combines adventure game style puzzle solving, atmospheric level design and traditional shooter mechanics.
You can follow here for updates, or:
https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-kepler-experiment
https://bsky.app/profile/cosmicmallard.bsky.social
